title.zh: MIT 18.02SC 多变量微积分：全课程小游戏

en.a: Planned: 69 games covering all 102 sessions and 5 exams of the Fall 2010 course; games appear here as they are finished.
en.b: Each game links its own lecture notes, problems and solutions, and uses figures where the geometry matters.

zh.a: 计划：69 个游戏覆盖 2010 秋季课程的全部 102 个课节和 5 场考试；完成的游戏会陆续出现在这里。
zh.b: 每个游戏都附有对应的讲义、习题与答案，几何内容配有图形。

references: MIT OpenCourseWare, 18.02SC Multivariable Calculus, Fall 2010 (Prof. Denis Auroux)
